messages.subject: Welcome to the MailBurrow demo
messages.textBody:
Hi there,

Everything you see here is fictional sample mail built into the app. Nothing is downloaded, and no server is involved.

Try searching for "invoice", filtering by date, switching to the bakery account, opening the long meeting notes or saving an attachment.

Exit the demo any time from the banner or from Settings.

This is fictional sample mail included with MailBurrow's demo mode.
